messages:
Anya Kapoor: Heads-up: planning to push kernel-quant v3.2.1 to staging in the 23:00 UTC quiet window. Patch contains matmul kernel swap + q8 pack. No API changes.
Mike H.: what's the smoke checklist? canary size?
Anya Kapoor: canary = 1% traffic in staging (internal). smoke steps: run perf smoke, run kv-cache acceptance, token-level fidelity check against golden prompt set. I'll paste commands.
Anya Kapoor: ```
# preflight
./deployctl check kernel-quant:v3.2.1 --smoke
./tools/perf-smoke --timeout 300 --targets=staging-slice-1
```
DeployBot: preflight OK. binary checksum matches. rolling to staging: kernel-quant:v3.2.1 -> nodes: staging-*-pool
Cassie Miller: tagging release-notes? I can draft short blurb.
Anya Kapoor: included: "matmul kernel swap for latency improvement; q8 pack reduces memory by ~2x." Also add rollback steps and pin TTL.
Liam O.: pin TTL? we should pin v3.2.0 on prod for 2h if we start rollout.
Anya Kapoor: plan: staging at 23:00, bake 30m, then daytime prod rollout 02:00 UTC small slice 5% for 30m. pin TTL 120m if anomalies. Backout condition: >5% error rate or token-latency p95 >200ms.
OpsBot: Alert policy created: runtime/quant/errors > 5% over 5m -> @oncall-alert. Also added perf watchdog.
Mike H.: if we need to rollback, what's command?
Anya Kapoor: rollback command: ```
./deployctl rollback runtime kernel-quant:v3.2.0 --force --notify='rollback due to perf' 
``` Manual unpin: ```
./deployctl pin set kernel-quant:v3.2.0 --ttl 120m
```
Cassie Miller: I'll add to release notes and call out risk: thermal regressions on some GPU types. tagging @infra to monitor.
DeployBot: staging rollout complete. canary metrics: p95 latency -2.1% vs baseline, errors unchanged. Perf smoke passed.
Liam O.: :thumbsup: schedule prod push for 02:00 UTC then. I'll own rollout and monitoring.
Anya Kapoor: I'll remain on standby. if metrics flap, we'll pin and rollback. Also notify client-facing release notes.
Mike H.: adding a quick synthetic stress to watch for kv-cache eviction.
Cassie Miller: draft RN pushed: "kernel-quant v3.2.1: MatMul swap and q8 packing. Expected 10-20% latency reduction on long sequences. See internal KB link: https://go/internal/rn/kernel-quant-3.2.1"
Liam O.: starting prod slice at 02:00 UTC.
DeployBot: prod slice started (5%). monitoring hooks: perf, errors, token-ops. ETA next check in 10m.
Anya Kapoor: update: first 10m looks clean. continue.
OpsBot: Watchdog: token-latency p95 = 195ms (threshold 200ms) ; errors 0.9% (threshold 5%). all green.
Mike H.: continuing kv-cache stress. will update in 20m.
Cassie Miller: noted. RN updated. tagging #release-notes for visibility.
Liam O.: rolling to 25% now.
DeployBot: prod rollout at 25%. note: some machines with older driver model show slightly higher memory churn — ops watching.
Anya Kapoor: if memory churn rises >12% we'll pin and revert.
Liam O.: copy. Will hold at 25% for 20m.
DeployBot: rollout complete to 100% (staged ramp). summary: p95 -3.8%, errors -0.1%, no rollback triggered. 
Cassie Miller: nice work everyone :party_parrot: I'll close RN and send internal note.
Anya Kapoor: thanks team. followup: open follow-up ticket to run more thermal sims on driver-legacy fleet.
Mike H.: filing ticket now -> TICKET-4321
Liam O.: moving thread to archive after oncall confirms 24h stability.
DeployBot: auto-note: pin TTL cleared.
